meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

copy.tagline: 集成微信个人号消息收发，无需付费Token
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将微信个人号接入自动化流程
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WeChat personal account messaging without paid tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect WeChat personal account to automation workflows

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会用腾讯官方 iLink 接口把个人微信号变成机器人渠道:扫码登录、无需 webhook;把会话接到 agent 群后,微信消息会触发回复。
howto.when: 用户要求接入个人微信、把微信加为机器人渠道,或在 /setup 里走到微信这一步时。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 开始复制适配器并安装依赖。

say.text: 把扫码登录的微信接到一个 agent 组
say.note: 运行 wire-dm.ts 完成接线。

say.text: 设置微信陌生人来消息先审批
say.note: 用 request_approval 策略创建接线。

howto.what_en: Adds WeChat (personal account) as a NanoClaw channel via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. It copies the adapter, installs the pinned client, enables QR login with no webhook; once wired, the bot replies to WeChat messages.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to add WeChat integration, add WeChat as a channel, or reaches the WeChat step in /setup.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and installing the dependency.

say_en.text: Wire the QR-logged WeChat to an agent group
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts to finish the wiring.

say_en.text: Make stranger WeChat messages require approval
say_en.note: Creates the wiring with request_approval policy.
